Subject: Aurelia immersion day — proposed dates and logistics

Hi Simon / Elena,

Great to continue the conversation — we’d love to host an in-person immersion at our Novato HQ so your product and platform teams can try an integration sandbox and validate performance on a representative workload. 

Proposed window: Tues 10/26 or Thurs 10/28 (arrive ~9:30am, depart ~3:30pm). We can provide the West conference room + adjacent staging room for laptops and test fixtures. Quick asks:
- Can you confirm number of attendees (heads) and any laptop OS constraints?
- Do you need a Redwood demo VM image or can teams bring their own?
- Are there any additional compliance controls we should prepare (e.g., isolated network, on-site laptop restrictions)?

I’ve attached a preliminary run-of-show and a mutual NDA draft for signature. If those dates work I’ll coordinate parking passes and badging — Novato campus has limited visitor parking so I’ll pre-book two passes and share arrival instructions.

Would love a quick call tomorrow if you want to run through the agenda.

Thanks,
Naomi
